Dutch Design Week (DDW) returns to the essence of design in 2026. Under the theme R.A.W. (Rebel Authentic Worth), DDW embraces the unpolished, exploratory and experimental. A place where designers challenge existing ideas, explore new possibilities and reveal how change takes shape. For nine days, DDW brings together the full breadth of design.

content.text: {"events":[],"reason":"The only official page fetched (ddw.nl/en) exclusively describes Dutch Design Week 2026 (17-25 October 2026, Eindhoven) — the current/upcoming edition. There is no announcement, news item, or future-dates section referencing a 2027 edition anywhere on this page; all news items and the hero banner refer to 2026 (DDW26). Per instructions, an old date must not be moved forward a year and recurrence is not evidence. Since no 2027 edition has been officially announced on the fetched page, and I am limited to at most two fetches total (one already used), I cannot confirm any Dutch Design Week edition falling within the requested 2026-12-05 to 2027-12-31 window, nor any other qualifying multi-day festival/conference/championship within 25 km of Eindhoven from this source. No events can be returned with confidence from actual fetched facts."}
